Definition
[Horizontal metric and its curvatures on a surgery space-time] ↗ def:horizontal-subbundle

A horizontal metric $G$ is a smooth metric on ${\mathcal HT}({\mathcal M})$. Its restriction $G(t)$ to $M_t$ has the usual Levi--Civita connection, gradient, curvature operator $\Rm _G$, Ricci tensor $\Ric _G$, and scalar curvature $R_G$. These horizontal tensors vary smoothly over the surgery space-time.
